# Alleppey Booking

> Verified Kerala Backwater Houseboat & Boating Experiences

Alleppey Booking is a premier booking service for verified private houseboats, sharing boathouses, Shikara boat rides, kayaking, and speedboat tours in Alleppey (Alappuzha) backwaters, Kerala, India.

## Contact & Booking Information
- Website: https://alleppeybooking.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70127 61588
- Direct WhatsApp Booking: https://wa.me/917012761588
- Boarding Jetty: Finishing Point Road, Alappuzha, Kerala 688013, India
- Operating Hours: Open Daily 24/7 (Booking Desk: 6:00 AM - 11:00 PM IST)

## Private Houseboat Fleet (Bedroom Categories)
Every private houseboat is 100% exclusive to your group and includes a dedicated 3-member crew (Captain, Engine Driver, Chef) and all freshly prepared Kerala meals on board.

- [1 Bedroom Houseboat in Alleppey](https://alleppeybooking.com/1-bedroom-houseboat-alleppey/) (Most Popular for Couples): 1 AC bedroom, attached private bathroom, capacity 2 Adults (Up to 4 with extra beds). Starting at ₹11,000/night. Inclusions: Captain, private chef, backwater cruise, welcome drink, lunch, evening tea/snacks, dinner, and breakfast.

## Day Cruises & Backwater Activities
- [Sharing Houseboat in Alleppey](https://alleppeybooking.com/sharing-houseboat-in-alleppey/): Budget-Friendly Backwater Cruising with Private AC Room Starting from ₹5,999 / Couple. Capacity: Private AC Room on Shared Vessel (1-2 Adults). Duration: Overnight (12:00 PM to 9:00 AM Next Day).
- [Alleppey Shikara Boat Ride](https://alleppeybooking.com/shikara-ride-in-alleppey/): Glide Through Narrow Village Canals Traditional Style Starting from ₹800 / Hour. Capacity: 2 to 15 Guests per Shikara. Duration: 1 to 6 Hours (Hourly or Package Basis).
- [Alleppey Backwater Kayaking](https://alleppeybooking.com/kayaking-in-alleppey/): Paddle Through Serene Mangroves & Hidden Village Waterways Starting from ₹1,000 / Person. Capacity: Single & Tandem Kayaks Available. Duration: 2 to 4 Hours Guided Tour.
- [Alleppey Speed Boat Cruise](https://alleppeybooking.com/speed-boat-in-alleppey/): High-Speed Adrenaline & Quick Sightseeing Across Vembanad Lake Starting from ₹2,500 / Hour. Capacity: Up to 6-8 Passengers. Duration: 30 Minutes to 2 Hours.

## Key Houseboat Inclusions & Policies
- **Cruise Timings**: Overnight check-in at 12:00 PM, check-out at 9:00 AM next morning. Cruising runs from 12:00 PM to 5:30 PM (as mandated by Kerala Port & Canal safety regulations), anchors overnight by lake shore, and resumes morning cruise from 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM.
- **Meal Inclusions**: Authentic Kerala feast cooked onboard. Lunch (Kerala boiled rice, sambar, thoran, avial, fish fry / Karimeen option), evening tea/coffee with banana fritters (pazham pori), dinner (chicken roast / veg dishes, chapati, rice), and Kerala breakfast (appam with stew or idli/dosa).
- **Air Conditioning**: Deluxe category operates Night AC (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM). Premium and Luxury categories provide 24-Hour full-time AC in bedrooms and glass-covered living lounges.
- **Crew & Safety**: Every boat carries life jackets, fire extinguishers, first aid kit, and an experienced 3-member certified crew.
